offline_verifier_tests.note: These are offline regression cases, NOT ten GitHub uploads.

known_limitations: Only a 69-byte fixture was transmitted and compared in this experiment.
A real approved game PNG was not located by the Library searches; this does not establish absence from the Library.
Large-PNG payload capacity and unattended file-to-connector injection remain unverified.
GitHub.fetch_blob and generic GitHub.fetch PNG retrieval encounter UTF-8 decoding limitations; fetch_file with encoding=base64 succeeded.
No merge into main, game asset replacement, or service deployment was performed.
